questions.q:
The cost of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) per litre is increased by 65%. By what percentage must Manish reduce his consumption of CNG so as not to increase his expenditure? (correct up to two decimal places)

प्रति लीटर संपीड़ित प्राकृतिक गैस (सीएनजी) की कीमत में 65% की वृद्धि हुई है। मनीष को अपने सीएनजी की खपत में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी करनी चाहिए ताकि उसका खर्च न बढ़े? (दो दशमलव स्थानों तक सही)
questions.s:
Let old price = P

New price = 165% of P = 1.65P

Old consumption = C, new consumption = C'

Since, expenditure is same =>

P * C = 1.65P * C'

C = 1.65C'

Reduction = C - C' = 1.65C' - C' = 0.65C'

% reduction = (0.65C'/C) * 100 = 65C'/1.65C' = 65/1.65 ≈ 39.39%

questions.q: 6. District XYZ has 50,000 voters, out of them, 20% are urban voters and 80 % rural voters. For an election, 25 % of the rural voters were shifted to the urban area. Out of the voters in both rural and urban areas, 60% are honest,70% are hardworking and 35% are both honest and hardworking.
questions.s:
6.(a) Total votes = 50000
Urban voters = 20100×50000 = 10000

Rural voters = 80100×50000= 40000
Voters shifted to urban area from rural area = 10,000
⇒ Now, Urban votes = 10000 + 10000 = 20000 and Rural votes = 40000 - 10000 = 30000
Out of the voters in both rural and urban areas, 60% are honest, 70% are hardworking, and 35% are both honest and hardworking.
Voters who were both honest and hardworking voted for NOTA.
∴ Votes swept by NOTA = 35% of urban + 35% of rural = 35100×20000+35100×30000 = 17500
Candidate A found favour with the rural voters = 100% - 35% = 65% of rural voters
∴ Votes polled to A = 65100×30000 = 19500
Candidate B found favour with the urban voters = 100% - 35% = 65% of urban voters
∴ Votes polled to B = 65100×20000 = 13000
⇒ Votes polled in favor of candidate A, candidate B and NOTA are 19500, 13000 and 17500 respectively

9. In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 2545800 votes. If 365500 votes were declared invalid and 30% people did not cast their vote, what was the approximate number of people (in millions) in the electorate who did NOT cast their votes ?
questions.s:
9.(a)
Let the total valid votes be V.
The defeated candidate received 42% of the valid votes and lost by 2545800 votes.
Therefore, the winning candidate received = 100% - 42% = 58% of the valid votes
The difference in votes between the two candidates = 58% - 42% = 16% of the valid votes.
V × 16% = 2545800
V = 15,911,250
Total votes polled = 15,911,250 + 365500 = 16,276,750
30% of people did not cast their votes so 70% did cast their vote.
70% = 16,276,750
(people who did not cast their votes) 30% = 6,975,750
So, approximate number of people in the electorate who did not cast their votes is 7 million

⇒ अब, शहरी वोट = 10000 + 10000 = 20000 और ग्रामीण वोट = 40000 - 10000 = 30000
ग्रामीण और शहरी दोनों क्षेत्रों के मतदाताओं में से 60% ईमानदार हैं, 70% मेहनती हैं, और 35% दोनों ईमानदार और मेहनती हैं।
ईमानदार और मेहनती दोनों मतदाताओं ने नोटा को वोट दिया।
∴ नोटा द्वारा डाले गए वोट = 35% शहरी + 35% ग्रामीण =35100× 20000 +35100×30000 = 17500
उम्मीदवार A को ग्रामीण मतदाताओं का समर्थन मिला = 100% - 35% = 65% ग्रामीण मतदाता
∴ A को मिले वोट = 65100×30000 = 19500
उम्मीदवार B को शहरी मतदाताओं का समर्थन मिला = 100% - 35% = शहरी मतदाताओं का 65%
∴ B को डाले गए वोट =65100× 20000 = 13000
⇒ उम्मीदवार A, उम्मीदवार B और NOTA के पक्ष में पड़े वोट क्रमश: 19500, 13000 और 17500 हैं

questions_hin.q_hi: 9. दो उम्मीदवारों के बीच एक चुनाव में 10% मतदाताओं ने वोट नहीं डाले और 75 वोट अमान्य पाए गए। विजेता को अपेक्षित कुल वोटों के 50% वोट मिले और वह 170 वोटों से जीत गया। मतदाता सूची में कितने मतदाताओं का नाम दर्ज है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
9.(d)
माना कुल वोट = 100x%
मतदाताओं ने अपना वोट डाला = 90x%
वैध वोट = 90x% - 75
विजेता को मिले वोट = 50x%
हारने वाले को मिले वोट = (90x% - 75) - 50x% = (40x% - 75)
प्रश्न के अनुसार,
50x% - (40x% - 75) = 170
(10x% + 75) = 170 वोट
100% (वोट पड़े) = 170-7510 × 100 = 950

questions_hin.q_hi:
A gave 30% of his amount to B and 30% of the remaining amount to C. If C has ₹1176, then find the amount that A gave to B.

A अपनी धनराशि का 30% भाग B को और शेष धनराशि का 30% भाग C को देता है। यदि C के पास ₹1176 है, तो A द्वारा B को दी गई धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the amount = ₹100a

30% of (100 - 30)%*100a = 1176

a = 1176/21

a = 56

So, the amount that A gave to B = 30% of 5600 = ₹1680
